title: All-mask silhouette-hull floater relocation for field-only distillation on Janelle frame 00008 (exact CPU-index decoding retry)
question: When the masks of all 26 calibrated views define a visual hull and Gaussians that any view's dilated silhouette rejects are actively moved into that hull during field-only distillation, does novel-view colour inside the two held-out masks improve over the masked objective alone?
hypothesis: H1: nb_ms_reloc improves held-out foreground PSNR over nb_ms by at least 0.1 dB with crop LPIPS no worse than +0.005 in every paired seed. Descriptive: the same comparison with photograph targets, and field versus photograph targets with and without relocation.
claim_boundary: Development screen on one previously outcome-exposed frame (RTGS-021/024/025 used it), one split with two held-out colour views, three paired seeds and one 8000-step budget at downscale 8. The masks of all 26 views, including both held-out views, define the visual hull by the user's design, so held-out alpha, floater and hull-rejection metrics are in-sample; only held-out colour is a novel-view measurement. Training packed alpha is mask-derived; the field arms are field-plus-silhouette and the photograph arms photograph-plus-silhouette. No default, SOTA, generalization, physical-geometry or speed claim. The conditional all-view production model has no held-out view and is not evidence. Relocation also re-places the random initialization: most random start points lie outside the hull and move to its surface at the first event, so H1 measures the method as a whole (hull-guided placement plus ongoing relocation), not ongoing relocation alone. Before protocol review, a non-protocol driver smoke (60 iterations, two training views standing in for held-out, no real held-out colour) exposed relocation counts, hull size and a meaningless 60-iteration gate value to the Driver; no threshold changed afterwards. This task repeats the approved design of 20260927_silhouette_relocation_stage_frame00008, whose single run failed closed at its CUDA-versus-CPU decoder-parity gate (1.889e-4 at 1 of 512 sites of training view C0026, a near-empty normalized-blend region) before any initialization, fitting cell or held-out access; the only design change is exact CPU-index decoding. The Driver diagnosed that site after the failure; no reconstruction outcome exists from the predecessor.

stages.label: Prepare targets and hull masks
stages.purpose: Decode the 24 training compact views with the exact CPU tile index (reference-scan parity), prepare training photograph targets for the control arms only, and decode packed alpha of all 26 views for the hull; held-out colour is not decoded.

stages.label: Hull and initialization
stages.purpose: Build the occupied visual-hull voxels from all 26 dilated masks and the seeded random initialization shared by every cell of a seed.

stages.label: 3DGS fitting
stages.purpose: Identical gsplat Trainer, masked objective and budget; only target family and opt-in relocation vary.

stages.label: Final reporting
stages.purpose: Score colour inside the two held-out masks against held-out photographs; alpha and hull metrics are in-sample diagnostics.

comparators.label: no_boundary fields / masked objective
comparators.purpose: RTGS-025 main-path baseline on this split, no relocation.

comparators.label: photographs / masked objective + relocation
comparators.purpose: Descriptive relocation effect under photograph targets.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: Squared RGB error of the black-background render against the held-out photograph over the fixed held-out binary mask only, -10log10 per view; mean of the two views per seed; report every view, seed and paired delta.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out masked-crop LPIPS
primary_metrics.aggregation: AlexNet LPIPS(normalize=True) on render and photograph both multiplied by the held-out mask, cropped to the mask box padded 8 px; per-view mean per seed.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out outside-mask alpha mass (in-sample)
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean rendered alpha outside the held-out mask dilated by 3 output pixels; per-view mean per seed; in-sample because the held-out masks define the hull.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out floater pixel fraction (in-sample)
primary_metrics.aggregation: Fraction of pixels outside the 3-pixel-dilated held-out mask with rendered alpha >= 0.5; per-view mean per seed; in-sample.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out interior coverage
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean rendered alpha inside the held-out mask eroded by 3 output pixels; per-view mean per seed.

primary_metrics.label: Final hull-rejected Gaussian fraction (in-sample)
primary_metrics.aggregation: Fraction of final Gaussian centres rejected by the frozen all-view hull; one value per cell, repeated on each held-out row.

resource_protocol.scope: Fresh process per fitting cell including loading, hull construction and final save; target decoding and evaluation timed separately. Local desktop GPU possibly shared; descriptive only. The driver resets CUDA peaks after warmup; the Trainer does not reset them again.
resource_protocol.aggregation: All three paired seeds retained; no speed inference.

preprocessing.target_operator: Field targets: rtgs.data.field_targets.decode_compact_view(downscale=8, supersample=2, backend="index") (exact CPU tile index; the CUDA query kernel is not used) of the 24 training views; photograph targets: the same four edge-origin sites, bilinear grid_sample(align_corners=False) of the undistorted full-resolution photograph, clamped. The Trainer supervises target*mask + random_background*(1-mask) with L1 weight 0.1 + 0.9*mask; boundary pixels with fractional alpha include outside-mask target colour in proportion to the fraction (RTGS-025 B2).
preprocessing.training_masks: Soft packed-alpha fraction of each training view from the no_boundary compact views (decode_alpha_grid, supersample 2). prepare aborts unless each training view's packed alpha equals its thresholded lossless source mask, the compact view records the sealed photograph and mask SHA-256, and no training pixel with alpha > 0 lies outside the fit window. evaluate repeats the packed-alpha equality check for the two held-out views.
preprocessing.decoder_parity: Per training view: 512 in-window sites from torch.Generator seed 926200 + training-view index; CPU index vs reference scan max abs <= 1e-5, else abort. No CUDA decoder is used for targets, the held-out field-consistency diagnostic or production.

hull.definition: rtgs.optim.silhouette_relocation.SilhouetteHull over the 26 downscale-8 cameras and packed-alpha fractions thresholded at 0.5 and dilated by 1 output pixel. A point is rejected when any camera sees it in front (depth > near) and in frame outside its dilated silhouette; occupied voxels are lattice centres over the bound cube (extent = full diameter from rtgs.data.calibrated._object_bounds on the 24 training cameras and masks) that no view rejects and at least one view sees inside. Abort if an occupied voxel lies on a lattice face or fewer than minimum_voxels are occupied.

relocation.definition: rtgs.optim.silhouette_relocation.SilhouetteRelocator via Trainer.train(parameter_step_callback=...): at completed steps 500, 600, ..., 7000, every hull-rejected Gaussian centre moves to its nearest occupied voxel plus uniform in-voxel jitter (fallback to the voxel centre if the jitter leaves the hull), and its exp_avg/exp_avg_sq rows are zeroed in every parameter group. Colour, scale, rotation and opacity are kept; the count never changes. Relocation events are recorded per cell. The gsplat Default strategy refines on the iteration after an event using screen-gradient statistics accumulated partly at pre-relocation positions for relocated rows. The installed gsplat 1.5.3 never executes its opacity reset (operator precedence in strategy/default.py makes the reset condition always false), so opacity_reset_every is inert in every arm, as it was in RTGS-025.

initialization.random: 20000 points uniform in the ball of radius 0.5 x extent about the bound center (float64 draws from the paired seed), isotropic scale = mean nearest-neighbour distance, opacity 0.1, colour 0.5 gray; byte-identical across the four cells of a seed and digest-checked in each worker.

scoring.evaluation_grid: Held-out cameras at downscale 8; held-out photograph and mask sampled with the four-site operator; mask binarized at 0.5 of the averaged samples.
scoring.diagnostic_only: Foreground PSNR of each model against the decoded held-out no_boundary field inside the held-out mask (field consistency), computed only in evaluate.
scoring.selection: Final 8000-step models only; no held-out selection.

decision_policy.h1_relocation: Pass iff for every paired seed nb_ms_reloc foreground PSNR >= nb_ms foreground PSNR + 0.1 dB and nb_ms_reloc crop LPIPS <= nb_ms crop LPIPS + 0.005 (evaluated in this written form). Reject iff for every paired seed nb_ms_reloc foreground PSNR <= nb_ms foreground PSNR - 0.1 dB. Otherwise inconclusive. No absolute quality floor.
decision_policy.descriptive: Photograph relocation pair and field-versus-photograph pairs with and without relocation are paired deltas with no pass/fail; in-sample alpha and hull metrics are mechanism descriptors.
decision_policy.consequence: A pass permits the production phase: one nb_ms_reloc model trained on all 26 views (fields plus packed alpha) with seed 9361, saved under runs/<task_id>/production/, declared not evidence. No default promotion.
decision_policy.stopping: Fixed final 8000 steps, no early stopping; abort a cell on non-finite values, CUDA OOM or 3600 s wall (timed_out receipt); stop the matrix on the first failure. One run invocation; a failure after prepare began consumes the root. The coordinator refuses to start on a root that already contains targets/ or preparation.json.

production.sequence: Only after the run completed, the independent results audit is persisted, the report is rendered with its viewer receipt, and both check-run and scripts/check_results_bundle.py pass on the evidence bundle, and only if h1_relocation == pass: run the production command once, then rerender once and rerun both gates so the manifest inventories production/. production/ is never listed as evidence and the production model never enters RESULT or AUDIT comparisons. Production runs as a single manual invocation outside the 3600 s cell limit.

execution_order.warmup: One disposable 32x32 two-Gaussian forward/backward CUDA render per fresh fitting worker, excluded from reported iterations.

execution_controls.rng_policy: After warmup, seed Python random, NumPy, torch CPU and all CUDA generators with the paired seed; the relocator's generator uses the paired seed; CUDA bitwise determinism is not assumed.

source_lifecycle: Official init-run from a clean tree; the coordinator archives the exact bound source before the first worker; no source mutation during execution.
